GST Appellate Tribunal Appeal Deadline Extended to July 31

The government has extended the deadline for filing appeals with the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) to July 31, 2026. This decision comes after taxpayers raised concerns about technical glitches on the GSTAT portal, which experienced a surge in filings. The extension aims to provide relief and ensure compliance.
